key_insight: Compass improves prostate cancer detection by analyzing micro-ultrasound as a multi-view study rather than isolated frames, using rotational context and biopsy-time video.
clinical_relevance: This approach could better match how expert readers assess micro-ultrasound exams and may help support prostate cancer diagnosis in clinical workflows.
method: Models a full micro-ultrasound study as a stream of 2D images
Combines rotational sweep videos with biopsy-acquisition frames
Uses a transformer conditioned on probe rotation to aggregate evidence and predict frame-level and study-level risk
evidence_signal: The method was trained and evaluated on a multi-center clinical trial dataset of micro-ultrasound studies and compared against published AI baselines and expert risk scores.
watch_item: Performance depends on high-quality multi-view video acquisition and may be harder to deploy where rotational scans or biopsy-time video are inconsistent.
paper_title: Compass: Prostate Cancer Detection Needs Multi-View Context
